summary: Iter-33 polish batch (4 new features) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 10/10 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter33_polish.py. (1) Guidance run for Gordons/House/3br/2ba/600/180 returns 3 comparables and every comp carries a populated `snapshot` object with all 8 required keys (property_subtype, bedrooms, bathrooms, land_area_m2, building_area_m2, suburb, street, local_area). (2) GET /api/admin/market/health-led/config returns {amber_min_success_pct: 90.0 (float), red_consecutive_failures: 2 (int)} against the seeded active config, and 401s without auth. (3) POST /api/public/leads with source=price_compare + captcha + workflow=seller creates a Lead in admin /api/leads with source=price_compare, assigned_agent_id set, customer_id set, and a Customer with customer_type='buyer'. Workflow=landlord routes to a leasing_agent (assigned agent's role verified via /api/users lookup), while seller routes to sales_agent. (4) 60s TTL analytics cache: two calls within ~0.5s to each of source-strip, price-trends, median-by-suburb, heatmap, quick-insights return deep-equal JSON bodies. FRONTEND (Playwright): (a) Retention tab (/admin/market/config → Data Retention) exposes `input-led-amber-min` and `input-led-red-streak`; changed to 85/3, published as COMBINED-9.512, reloaded — values persisted. `retention-preview-btn` opens `retention-preview-result` table. `agg-health-led` badge visible in top-nav ('Pipeline 8'). (b) Comparables page: run-guidance-btn produces 3 comp-row-* rows, clicking opens comp-detail-modal, `toggle-compare-subject` checkbox visible; toggling ON reveals `compare-with-subject` table with 8 rows containing all expected labels (Suburb, Property subtype, Bedrooms, Bathrooms, Land area, Building area, Street, Local area); toggling OFF removes the table. (c) /price-compare/seller: filled Gordons → pc-submit → pc-result shows K666k-K889k range with 3 comps; pc-lead-cta + pc-lead-open-btn visible; filled name/email/phone/notes/captcha (extracted 5-char code '32BXA' from form text) → pc-lead-submit-btn → pc-lead-thanks toast + banner. Lead visible in admin /api/leads with source=price_compare and matching Customer. Cleaned up test lead+customer. Restored health-led config to defaults (90/2) via a fresh COMBINED-restore-* version.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/market.py: `import time as _time` is placed mid-file below the docstring block instead of the top imports section — cosmetic but breaks lint-order conventions.

The analytics TTL cache is a per-process dict — in a multi-worker uvicorn deployment each worker will have its own cache, so identical calls hitting different workers could still return divergent (freshly-computed) payloads. Not observed in this preview env (single worker) but worth noting for prod scale-out.
